definition: The straight line that touches the curve $y = f(x)$ at the point $(a, f(a))$ and has the curve's gradient $f'(a)$ there, so its equation is $y - f(a) = f'(a)(x - a)$.

The straight line through a point $(a, f(a))$ of the curve $y = f(x)$ that is perpendicular to the tangent there; its gradient is $-\frac{1}{f'(a)}$ when $f'(a) \neq 0$, and it is the vertical line $x = a$ when $f'(a) = 0$.
